query: SELECT transitions, ARRAY_AGG(asset_id) as assets FROM (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(jsonb_build_object('schema', bsa.schema_id, 'begins', bsa.begins, 'schedule', bs.schedule, 'slot_price', slot_price) ORDER BY bsa.begins) as transitions, bsa.asset_id FROM bookable_schema_assignments bsa JOIN bookable_schemas bs ON bs.id = bsa.schema_id WHERE bsa.asset_id = ANY($1) AND bsa.begins <= $2::date group by bsa.asset_id) group by transitions;
